# qpOASES_e starts reporting infeasible when the number of variables approaches 50, is this always due to an infeasible QP?

> **Current answer:** Not necessarily. The maintainer's note indicates that qpOASES_e uses static memory with a default compile-time limit of 50 variables and 100 constraints. First, compare the actual nV/nC with QPOASES_NVMAX and QPOASES_NCMAX; if it exceeds the limit, modify `include/qpOASES_e/Constants.h` and recompile. Since the original post does not provide a recompiled author's verification, the memory usage and solution result must still be validated on the target hardware.

- Increase the two upper limits in `include/qpOASES_e/Constants.h` and recompile all code dependent on this header file.
